name: a1v3-vo-tara-1
text: Apni factory ke liye address chahiye? Toh yeh dekhiye! Rohtak mein, 138 acre ka industrial park. Plots, 500 se 4,000 gaj tak. 24 metre wide roads, trucks ke liye. Apna electrical substation, STP, CCTV aur fire safety. Highway sirf 10 minute. Aur Haryana MSME policy mein... 25% tak capital subsidy! Stamp duty pe 75% back, aur SGST pe 60% tak back! Apna gate. Apna board. Apna address. Forteasia Industrial Township, Rohtak. More details ke liye, humse WhatsApp pe baat kijiye!
